name: FileRowItem
description: One downloadable file: type glyph, name, size and type, and a download button.
signature: ({ file, as: Row }: { file: ResultFile; as?: "li" | "div"; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: as
props.description: The row's element. `li` must sit directly under a `ul` or `ol`; use `div` for a row outside a list.

props.name: file
props.description: The file to list: `name` and `mime` pick the glyph and type, `size` is in bytes, and `href` makes the button a download link.
